styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF sweep for front and back air-form packshots and the variant row, cool mist grey #EAEFF4 for the ruled callout screen, deeper steel greys for pain-point and scene depth, cool porcelain #E9EEF3 for the stitch macro
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key cool studio light with a front or front-left key and a soft fill card, gentle contact shadow under the hem, soft skimming light only on weave and stitch macros, no harsh speculars, 5600K daylight balance in the scene screen
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio paper #FFFFFF and cool mist board #EAEFF4, fabric laid directly on the same field for macros
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, hairline ruled callout slots only, all garment lettering supplied as placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline rules, blank caption slots and one letterless seal ring in graphite #2C333A, no filled badges and no pictograms
styleLock.presentationRules: the shirt reads as one and the same garment across the set: collar spread and squared, placket straight, cuffs folded back identically, stable hero scale on an invisible ghost form
noDrift: no color palette changes beyond #FFFFFF, #EAEFF4, #2C333A and #3E5C76, the only reserved neutrals being steel #D6DCE3, scene grey #B9C3CC and the macro fields #F2F5F8 and #E9EEF3
no mixed fonts, no serif, script or brush lettering
no random scenic backgrounds or gradient sweeps
no inconsistent lighting or warm cast drift between shots
no collar-shape, cuff-fold or placket drift between shots
no visible mannequin, hanger or model identity
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent crisp air-form menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF, cool mist grey #EAEFF4, graphite text #2C333A and one steel-blue accent #3E5C76; bright even high-key cool studio lighting with a front-left key, soft fill and gentle contact shadows, soft skimming light reserved for weave and stitch macros; modern geometric sans-serif; hairline rules and letterless blank slots instead of badges; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable squared-collar hero scale on an invisible ghost form; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 纯白底正面空气衣（隐形模特）长袖衬衫，翻领、明门襟、四孔扣、反折袖口、圆弧下摆；002 同底后背视图，可见后过肩育克缝、袖衩与圆弧下摆；003 领座与领内特写，领内带织标与尺码标；004 左侧衬衫、右侧三条横线加三行英文主张的卖点图；005 白色布面旋成涡状的织纹特写；006 袖口、门襟扣眼与明线的斜向微距。品类判定依据：全部画面均为有领、有门襟、有袖克夫的男装外穿长袖正装衬衫，非针织 T 恤也非贴身睡衣，故归「男装／上衣」，leaf 取男士免烫长袖正装衬衫；原平台类目标注仅作线索，以图为准。已剥离内容：领内字标、系列名、产地与尺码标字样、原品牌与系列名、004 的三行英文主张原句（改为三条空线 callout 占位）、原平台店铺字样与任何水印角标；源图无真人模特，场景镜改用颈下裁切的通用成年男模，不含任何身份与面容信息。产品一律以 {product} 占位，面料成分、弹性数值与工艺等级均未写死，全部留为占位或空白证据位。
